evidence.statement: AppHost declares Redis, RabbitMQ (eventbus, persistent container), Postgres (ankane/pgvector:latest, persistent) with four databases (catalogdb, identitydb, orderingdb, webhooksdb) on one server; projects identity-api, basket-api, catalog-api, ordering-api, order-processor, payment-processor, webhooks-api, webhooksclient, webapp; YARP mobile-bff; Azure Container App environment aca. One eventbus reference is passed to basket, catalog, ordering, order-processor, payment-processor, webhooks-api and webapp.
evidence.limitations: Configuration observation; deployed topology not observed.

evidence.statement: WithExternalHttpEndpoints() is applied to identity-api, mobile-bff and webapp only. Basket, catalog, ordering, webhooks-api, webhooksclient, order-processor and payment-processor have no external-endpoint call (webhooksclient is referenced from identity config as an HTTP callback target).
evidence.limitations: Whether ACA ingress matches this after deployment is not observed (G1).

evidence.statement: mobile-bff YARP routes /api/catalog/{*any} (catch-all, api-version 1.0|1|2.0 query match) to catalog-api, /api/orders/{*any} (api-version 1.0|1) to ordering-api, /identity/{*any} to identity-api, plus explicit /catalog-api/api/catalog/... read routes. The catalog catch-all matches any method under /api/catalog/; no per-route HTTP method restriction appears in the configuration read.
evidence.limitations: Effective generated YARP configuration not observed (G2).

evidence.statement: PUT /api/catalog/items, PUT /items/{id}, POST /items and DELETE /items/{id} are mapped without RequireAuthorization(); a text search of Catalog.API Program, Extensions and Apis found no AddDefaultAuthentication, RequireAuthorization or Authorize. Update copies request-body values onto the entity (including Price and PictureFileName), recomputes the embedding and publishes ProductPriceChangedIntegrationEvent when Price changes (CatalogApi.cs:390-399). CreateItem accepts a client-supplied Id and PictureFileName (415-430).
evidence.limitations: CatalogApi.cs read in ranges 1-125, 251-272 (grep), 359-467 only; reachability from outside depends on G1 and G2.

evidence.statement: The picture endpoint resolves item.PictureFileName through a PhysicalFileProvider rooted at ContentRoot/Pics and streams the file. PictureFileName is client-writable via E4. The latest commit message in session context ('Confine catalog picture reads to Pics (#1061)') suggests a recent path-confinement fix.
evidence.limitations: Provider-level confinement not tested; commit message is a session-context claim, Git was not used.

evidence.statement: If the Identity config section is absent, authentication is not registered (24-28). Otherwise JwtBearer with RequireHttpsMetadata = false (39), ValidateAudience = false (49) although Audience is set (40), ValidIssuers = [identityUrl] plus an Android emulator issuer under #if DEBUG (42-44). No scope or role policy; AddAuthorization() default only (52).
evidence.limitations: Per-service configuration of the Identity section not confirmed (G4).

evidence.statement: All order routes require an authenticated caller (group RequireAuthorization()). GET api/orders/{orderId} returns any order by id with no owner filter (OrderQueries.cs:8-10). PUT /cancel and PUT /ship act on OrderNumber from the body with no owner check and no admin role or scope check (OrdersApi.cs:22-78; a handler comment says an administrator executes ship). POST / takes UserId, UserName, address and card data from the request body rather than the token sub (OrdersApi.cs:118-185; the identity service exists but is not used there). POST /draft builds a draft from a client BuyerId. Only GET / uses the token subject (93-98).
evidence.limitations: Read of the listed files only; validators and behaviors unread (G8).

evidence.statement: The API masks the card number (keeps last 4) before building the command (OrdersApi.cs:140) but passes CardSecurityNumber, holder name and expiration through the command, domain event and into the Order/PaymentMethod aggregate; a CardNumber column exists. Logging of the command is guarded in the create handler only by a comment (OrdersApi.cs:126-130); the IdentifiedCommand log at 148-153 uses {@Command} and CreateOrderCommandHandler logs {@Order} (CreateOrderCommandHandler.cs:47).
evidence.limitations: Persistence of the security number not traced (G6); Order.cs and entity configurations read by grep and partial ranges only.

evidence.statement: A duplicate x-requestid returns a canned success result. The request id is recorded before the inner command runs and is not removed when the inner command throws (catch { return default; }, 99-102), so a failed first attempt consumes the id.
evidence.limitations: RequestManager.cs listed, not read (G8).

evidence.statement: MapGrpcService<BasketService>() has no service-level RequireAuthorization. GetBasket is [AllowAnonymous] and returns an empty basket without a subject; UpdateBasket and DeleteBasket throw Unauthenticated when sub is empty. Basket keys are /basket/{sub} taken only from the token; the request message carries no buyer id. Baskets are JSON in Redis with no TTL set in code. If the Identity section is missing (E6), no authentication scheme exists and sub is always empty.
evidence.limitations: Redis network access and credentials not observed (G3).

evidence.statement: Any authenticated user can register Url (destination) and GrantUrl; validation is Uri.IsWellFormedUriString plus a same scheme/host/port check between the two. The service sends an HTTP OPTIONS request to GrantUrl from the Webhooks.API network position with a caller-chosen token in header X-eshop-whtoken and requires the response to echo the token. WebhooksSender later POSTs JSON payloads to DestUrl. No block-list for loopback, private or link-local addresses, no scheme restriction beyond well-formedness, no redirect policy and no timeout or size limits were observed (default IHttpClientFactory.CreateClient()). The token is written to logs (GrantUrlTesterService.cs:17,25).
evidence.limitations: Egress network policy unobserved (UB4); fan-out logic unread (G7).

evidence.statement: List, get and delete filter by UserId == user.GetUserId(). Payload fan-out and WebhooksRetriever were not read in detail; delivery by event type to all subscribers of that type is inferred from file names only.
evidence.limitations: WebhooksRetriever and paid/shipped handlers unread (G7).

evidence.statement: /check (OPTIONS) and /webhook-received are unauthenticated. Token validation depends on configuration ValidateToken (parsed to false when absent, line 13). When on, comparison is plain string equality with a configured token. Both received and expected tokens are written to logs (35). The sample configured token is [REDACTED:sample-webhook-token].
evidence.limitations: Deployed configuration of ValidateToken not observed.

evidence.statement: In-memory clients: maui (code + PKCE required, secret, refresh tokens, scopes orders/basket/webhooks, 2h tokens), webapp (code, RequirePkce = false at line 90, secret, offline access), webhooksclient (code, secret), and three implicit-flow Swagger UI clients (basketswaggerui, orderingswaggerui, webhooksswaggerui; AllowAccessTokensViaBrowser = true). The three confidential-client secrets are the literal sample value hashed via Sha256() [REDACTED:sample-client-secret] (lines 52, 82, 118). Allowed scopes for webapp include webshoppingagg and for maui mobileshoppingagg, which are not defined in GetApiScopes() (18-26). evidence.statement: When a chat model connection exists (Foundry opt-in via UseFoundry, or Ollama via an in-code useOllama flag set false), WebApp builds a chat client with function invocation. User text and catalog item descriptions (attacker-influenceable via E4) reach the model. The system prompt restricts topics but is not an enforcement boundary. Chat history lives in the server-side circuit.
